rows.fact: The same EF Core LINQ query translates to different SQL on the SQL Server and Npgsql providers
rows.observed: Npgsql: -- @term_contains='%abc%' -- @p='10' SELECT o."Id", o."CustomerEmail", o."Number", o."PlacedAt", o."Total" FROM "Orders" AS o WHERE o."CustomerEmail" LIKE @term_contains ORDER BY o."Id" LIMIT @p | SqlServer: DECLARE @p int = 10; DECLARE @term_contains nvarchar(4000) = N'%abc%';  SELECT TOP(@p) [o].[Id], [o].[CustomerEmail], [o].[Number], [o].[PlacedAt], [o].[Total] FROM [Orders] AS [o] WHERE [o].[CustomerEmail] LIKE @term_contains ESCAPE N'\' ORDER BY [o].[Id]
